title: Security   Loss Prevention Management
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an important risk financing tool, but it is not the complete answer to risks, and is all too often used to finance the wrong category of risks."
Insurance is an important risk financing tool, but it is not the complete answer to risks, and is all too often used to finance the wrong category of risks.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an excellent starting point, because it does not require anyone to look beyond the activities in which they are themselves involved, and on which they will all feel they are to some extent expert."

Loss control is an excellent starting point, because it does not require anyone to look beyond the activities in which they are themselves involved, and on which they will all feel they are to some extent expert.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the risk manager's main method of combating risk."
Control is the risk manager's main method of combating risk.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a common reason for the establishment of mutual or captive insurance companies."
Dissatisfaction with insurers' rating methods is a common reason for the establishment of mutual or captive insurance companies.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means that, not only is the risk of sabotage of records increased, but also that of total loss by such causes as explosion or damage by aircraft."
Concentration of records means that, not only is the risk of sabotage of records increased, but also that of total loss by such causes as explosion or damage by aircraft.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the first strategy to be considered."
Avoidance is the first strategy to be considered.
fib: ______ is the easier of the two to estimate, but neither can ever be more than estimates, because both involve looking into the future.
Severity is the easier of the two to estimate, but neither can ever be more than estimates, because both involve looking into the future.
______ are the undetected ones which do not appear in the records.
successful frauds are the undetected ones which do not appear in the records.
______ are the opportunities open to an enterprise's management to deploy its human loss control resources to the best advantage.
Organisational resources are the opportunities open to an enterprise's management to deploy its human loss control resources to the best advantage.
______ are the first line of defence against any type of loss.
Human resources are the first line of defence against any type of loss.
______ is the responsibility of all to manage risk' will achieve little on its own.
A statement that 'it is the responsibility of all to manage risk' will achieve little on its own.
______ is a threat which does not only express itself as theft.
Crime is a threat which does not only express itself as theft.
